about: The film's sound-effect kit (MASTER_PLAN 6.3, critic H9) for the cue exporter (video/scripts/export-cues.ts -> tools/audio/cues.json, read by tools/audio/mix_master.py). Files live in .work/audio/sfx/ (not committed; rebuild: tools/audio/sfx_synth.py .work/audio/sfx --bpm 100 --riser-bars 2 and tools/audio/sfx_foley.py .work/audio/kenney .work/audio/sfx .work/audio/sfx/foley-manifest.json). Rotate the takes in order for repeated events. t = the picture event's frame / 30 + 1 frame (except the riser, whose END sits on the reveal downbeat). Gains are starting points against the -18 LUFS bed, measured in the test mix (tools/audio/cues.example.json); check hits in the final mix's spectrogram. At most 2-3 effects at once; hits 3-6 dB above the bed; duck the bed 2-3 dB for 0.6 s under the reveal hit. No chimes, dings or meme sounds. Final-mix changes (lane M2, 2026-10-23): click -12 -> -9 dB (click_b sat thin against the sampled bed's strings and piano at 500-630 Hz); pop -13 -> -16 dB (on the end-card downbeat, pop_b, a plip on F#5, over the motif's D5 read as 'telephone' 0.255 in the social master). Lane fin-audio (2026-10-24, OVERRIDES §19): the pop at f2016 is gone from the timeline (thud_b and its duck stay), so pop is back to -13 dB. The energetic recut (ENERGY_SPEC §8.3-8.4, 2026-10-25): new roles impact, ui, rim, key and thump. impact_a/b, ui_card, ui_lock, ui_done, ui_verified, ui_forget and rim_a/b are unpitched takes that tools/audio/sfx_synth.py appends after its older takes, so seed 7 still writes those bit for bit. key reuses tick_c and thump reuses soft_hit_a. tick goes from -24 to -18 dB. ui_done replaces the tuned pop_a, ui_forget the pop_c plip, impact_a the reveal's soft_hit_b, and ui_verified shimmer_a. Pop, hit and shimmer stay in the kit, unused. The automation block holds the mix's ride, gaps, hold and tail: spans with no file, which never count as effects. Final mixes (the score lane, part 2, 2026-10-25), measured on scratch masters through mix_checks.py: impact -6 -> -4 dB, so that each hit (the impact, the effects peaking with it and the drive's own hit, K-weighted over the impact's peak +- 100 ms, against the bed as the mix plays it) sits 3-6 dB over the bed (the numbers below); more pushed the limiter and the AAC true peak. riser -10 -> -11 dB, with the drive's bar 7 1 dB down, so the drop sits 3 LU or more over the build on the web and x30 masters (3.34 and 3.05 LU on the final masters). rim on every beat of the hold (OVERRIDES §36: the hold window 29-34 s reads phone 0.166 web, 0.171 social, 0.164 x30, no voice or alarm label). The automation gains the hook's ride (OVERRIDES §36: the bed and the drive 1.5 dB down over bars 1-2; bars 1-2 then sit 4.89 LU under the web master, 4.71 social, 6.05 x30, where they sat 3.5, 3.3 and 4.8) and the tail's equal-power curve (with the fade linear in dB the final hit read 'foghorn' 0.46-0.59; the drive's bar 31 changes with it). Measured on the final masters (2026-10-25): the hits sit 3.4-5.6 dB over the bed (first slam 4.9, reveal 3.6, Verified 5.6, lift 3.4, breakdown 3.9, end-card landing 3.7, final hit 5.6).

pop.when: unused since the energetic recut (pitched pops; ui_done and ui_forget replace them)
pop.origin: Kenney Interface Sounds drop_002/003 (CC0), tuned to D major

tick.when: timeline rows arriving ('Requesting isolated tests' f1094; the app's own '· 11 s' f1146, alone in the breath)

thud.when: texture under the reveal hit and the end-card landing

whoosh.when: world changes (desktop -> window, window -> sandbox, -> sage field); the peak sits on the cut

riser.when: once: bars 6-7, its end on the reveal downbeat (beatmap cues.riser_end_frame)

hit.when: unused since the energetic recut (impact_a takes the reveal)

shimmer.when: unused since the energetic recut (ui_verified takes the Verified result)

impact.when: the hits: impact_a on the reveal f504 (duck 2.5 dB), the lift f1584 (1.5) and the final hit f2160 (2); impact_b, 60 % as long and dry, on Verified f1152 (1.5), the breakdown f1800 and the end-card landing f2016. The duck is the timeline's
impact.origin: synthesised (CC0): a 70 -> 32 Hz sine drop, a low-passed noise body, an 8 ms thwack; nothing tonal above 200 Hz

ui.when: UI events, each by name: ui_card the drawer opening with the edit card (f722), ui_done Done (f814), ui_lock AgentGuard holding the task (f890), ui_verified Verified (f1152), ui_forget the record dissolving (f1530)

rim.when: the hold's clock on every beat, f900, 918, 936, 954 and 972, alternating a and b (OVERRIDES §35 decision 3: beats 1 and 3 to begin with, every beat because the classifier stayed clean: the hold window reads phone 0.16 and no voice or alarm label)
rim.origin: synthesised (CC0): a 12 ms 2-6 kHz noise click; b is 1.5 dB softer and brighter

key.origin: Kenney Interface Sounds (CC0), the tick role's tick_c

thump.when: a soft thump under a line landing in the hold (T8, f936), where the drums are muted

automation.about: Mix automation (ENERGY_SPEC §8.3): spans, not effects. video/src/film/timeline.ts AUTOMATION -> video/scripts/export-cues.ts writes each into tools/audio/cues.json as an entry with NO 'file': {role, frame, to_frame, release_frame (the hold only), t = frame / fps, t_end = to_frame / fps, event, then this role's params}. tools/audio/mix_master.py applies them (a param the entry leaves out comes from here), tools/audio/cut_cues.py clips them to a cut's ranges, and tools/audio/mix_checks.py leaves them out of the cue report. They never count toward the three-effects limit, and effects are never gapped. Ramps into a span end on its frame (so the onset there is already down), and ramps out end on to_frame or release_frame (so the hit there plays at full level).

ride.when: the hook's ride (OVERRIDES §36: at most 2 dB on the bed and the drive over bars 1-2, the bed file unchanged): from f0 the bed and the drive sit 1.5 dB down, and come back in 4 ms on the first slam's hit frame (f144), with the hook's gap. The quiet open: bars 1-2 sit 4-8 LU under the master's integrated level (ENERGY_SPEC §8.5), where the kept bed's own bars 1-2 sit only 2.7 LU under the bed's

gap.when: the breath before a hit (f135, f1143, f1575, f2151; 9 frames, to_frame on the next bar line): the bed and the drive go down 24 dB in 10 ms and come back in 4 ms on the hit frame. The bed's pickup on the 'and' of 4 is swallowed

hold.when: AgentGuard holds the task (frame f891, the 'and' of beat 2): the drive is muted in 10 ms, and the bed crossfades in 30 ms to a copy through pedalboard LowpassFilter(1200) at -6 dB. At to_frame (the Run the tests click, f990) the drive is back. Over to_frame -> release_frame (f1008) the bed's crossfade and gain reverse on an ease-in curve, into the downbeat

tail.when: the film's end (f2214 -> f2250): the whole master, after the limiter, fades on an equal-power curve (curve 'sine': amplitude cos(pi u / 2), 1 -> 0 on to_frame; fade_to_db is the 'db' curve's floor, linear in dB, unused here), then is exact zeros to its last sample. Loudness is normalised as if the tail were already there. The score lane, part 2: the 'db' fade, which takes the final chord 30 dB down in its first 0.6 s, made SoundAnalysis hear the chord's onset and quick decay as 'foghorn' (0.46 web, 0.52 social, 0.59 x30; the same mixes with no fade at all read 0.12 and 0.24); the equal-power fade keeps the chord until the fade's last third
